package.description: Open-source movie and TV streaming client for Windows (Experimental)

en-US.description: Open-source movie and TV streaming client for Windows (Experimental)
en-US.longDescription:
Bisnor Cinema Desktop is an experimental open-source movie and TV streaming client for Windows,
built with .NET 10 and Microsoft WebView2. It supports internal playback, external media players,
downloads, account sync, and a Persian-focused interface.
en-US.name: Bisnor
